en.headline: Cheung Wah Estate water supply restored after Fanling burst
en.dek: Drinking and flushing water began returning to normal from about 1.30am, the Water Supplies Department said, while San Wan Road traffic controls remain for repairs.
body: Fresh and flushing water at Cheung Wah Estate in Fanling began returning to normal from about 1.30am on Thursday after a 200-millimetre fresh-water main burst near the estate entrance on Wednesday night, the Water Supplies Department said.

Police were called at about 10.31pm on Wednesday to San Wan Road, where muddy water about a foot deep was reported and part of the carriageway subsided. The department isolated the damaged main, which supplies both drinking and flushing water to the estate, and sent two water tankers plus 20 temporary tanks. A supply team also delivered fresh water to residents who needed it.

Repair crews were still working on the broken pipe on Thursday morning. The Transport Department said traffic on San Wan Road towards Tai Po must turn right into Fanling Station Road near the Cheung Wah Estate entrance, and vehicles heading towards Sheung Shui cannot turn right into the estate near Fanling Centre.
The Water Supplies Department thanked residents for their patience while emergency works continue.

zh.headline: 粉嶺祥華邸供水凌晨起回復 新運路仍封路搶修
zh.dek: 水務署表示食水及沖廁水約凌晨1時半起陸續恢復正常，新運路因水管及路面下陷繼續實施交通管制。
body: 粉嶺祥華邸食水及沖廁水周四凌晨約1時半起陸續恢復正常。水務署表示，事發於周三晚上，邸口附近一條200毫米食水配水管爆裂。
警方約晚上10時31分接報新運路有泥水湧出，水深約一呀，部分路面下陷。水務署截斷爆裂水管，該管同時供應邸內食水及沖廁水。署方調派兩輛水車及20個臨時水箱，並有專責隊伍向有需要居民送水。
搶修星期四早上仍在進行。運輸署公布，新運路往大埔方向近祥華邸入口須右轉入粉嶺車站路；往上水方向則不可在粉嶺中心附近右轉入祥華邸。
水務署感謝受影響居民在緊急維修期間的諒解及忍耐。
